items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: But we had a fellow named Rudy Wiedoft

ctx.x: I mean that's -- now, I mean I could see why you'd say that was a bastard instrument.

Yeah, that's what they call it, the old timers back there in those days when (unintelligible) Sax. No, that's a bastard instrument. But I heard one beautiful saxophone recital, this guy. I think he came from Czechoslovakia or Yugoslavia [Yascha Gurowitz] when he came to New York and gave a saxophone recital down at -- not Carnegie Hall. It was at (unintelligible) -- it was at Town Hall. But we had a fellow named Rudy Wiedoft --
